    {
      "title": "High frequency of vital signs and lab tests at every visit",
      "quote": "Vital Signsh | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X |  |  |",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Vital signs are collected at every visit including all weekly visits, which is burdensome for patients and staff, especially when visits are frequent.",
      "fix": "Consider reducing vital sign collection to visits where dosing or key assessments occur, or allow vital signs to be skipped if stable."
    },
    {
      "title": "Clinical labs at every visit including W6D2",
      "quote": "Clinical Laboratory Tests (hematology, serum chemistry, urinalysis)l | X | X | X | X | X | X | X |  | X | X | X |  |  |",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Clinical labs are drawn at every visit, including W6D2 which is an extra visit, increasing patient burden and site workload.",
      "fix": "Reduce lab frequency to align with dosing visits only, or combine W6D2 labs with W6D1 if possible."
    },
    {
      "title": "Tumor biopsy at W5D1 adds burden and may be difficult to collect",
      "quote": "Tumor Biopsyq | X |  |  |  |  | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "A tumor biopsy at W5D1 is an invasive procedure that adds significant patient burden and may be challenging to schedule and collect, especially if tumor is not easily accessible.",
      "fix": "Consider making the on-treatment biopsy optional or moving it to a time when it can be combined with another procedure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Pharmacokinetic sampling at W6D2 and W7D1 may be hard to meet",
      "quote": "Pharmacokinetic Samplingn |  | X |  |  |  |  | X | X | X |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "PK sampling on consecutive days (W6D2 and W7D1) requires patients to return for an extra visit and may be difficult to coordinate, especially if PK samples need precise timing.",
      "fix": "Consider consolidating PK sampling to a single visit or extending the window for W6D2 to allow flexibility."
    },
    {
      "title": "Disease assessment (radiographic imaging) only at EOT and PTFU may miss early progression",
      "quote": "Disease Assessment (radiographic imaging)r | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |  | X |",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Radiographic imaging is only performed at screening, EOT, and PTFU, which may be insufficient to capture early progression or response during treatment, especially for a cancer trial.",
      "fix": "Add interim imaging assessments (e.g., every 6-8 weeks) to monitor disease status more frequently."
    },
    {
      "title": "Adverse event monitoring continues through LTSFU but may be unnecessary",
      "quote": "Adverse Event Monitoringi | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X |",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "AE monitoring is listed for every visit including LTSFU, which is a phone call only; this may be burdensome for long-term follow-up and may not be required for late AEs.",
      "fix": "Limit AE monitoring to treatment period and 100DFU, and only collect serious AEs during LTSFU."
    },
    {
      "title": "Pregnancy test and FSH at W4D1 and EOT may be unnecessary for all patients",
      "quote": "Pregnancy Test and Follicle Stimulating Hormonel | X | X |  |  | X |  |  |  | X | X | X |  |  |",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Pregnancy tests and FSH are required at multiple visits, which may be burdensome for postmenopausal patients or those not of childbearing potential.",
      "fix": "Restrict pregnancy testing to women of childbearing potential only, and consider reducing frequency."
    },
    {
      "title": "Immunogenicity sampling at EOT and PTFU may be hard to collect",
      "quote": "Immunogenicity Samplingp | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |  | X |  | X |",
      "page": 13,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Immunogenicity sampling at EOT and PTFU requires patients to return for additional blood draws, which may be challenging for patients who have discontinued treatment and may not be feasible.",
      "fix": "Consider making immunogenicity sampling optional or aligning with other visits to reduce burden."
    }
  ]
}
